name: homecoming-rsvp-thisal-and-sirithi
description: RSVP page for the homecoming reception of Thisal & Sirithi
comment: The page itself has no dependencies and no build step. The one entry below is only for the serverless functions in api/ — it is what lets them reach Neon Postgres. Do not add a build script; Vercel serves the repo root as static files.
